description.value: Baking Factory is a bakery in a Richmond commercial complex on Cambie Road, presenting itself with an artisanal ethos centred on quality ingredients and hand-crafted flavors. OSM notes indoor seating is available, making it a potential sit-down rest stop for cyclists passing through the area. The business maintains an active social media presence via Facebook and Instagram.
